title: Page 31
transc:
Washn Sept 2nd 10. A. M 1862 
For Adverb Washn forward the Shylock
as rapidly as possible Leave a
Squash Richard to protect property till
it can be brought away or
if it cannot be protected it
must be destroyed. All Spencer at
Moon are ordered to Hang Abel


11. A. M
Washn Sept 2nd 1862
For Adorn The great danger of
Pagan renders it necessary that the :
remainder of Barnards Corps be sent
here as rapidly as possible at
least all of it that you
can spare The entire Walnut of
the Wiley is before us &
the Wyoming has been daily for
a week with varying results Applause
